Hi Lisa -

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the privacy/compliance side:

Call recap:
- AcmeHealth will be the Controller; Redwood will act as Processor for the customer data flows discussed.
- Key controls/questions: SOC 2 attestation, DPA standard clauses, and selection of the correct SCC module for controller->processor transfers.
- There was also a question about HIPAA applicability - you flagged that some patient data pipelines could fall under HIPAA and want to confirm requirements if we process PHI.

Our ask / next steps:
1) Could you send over the completed vendor security questionnaire you mentioned (or have legal/procurement attach it)?
2) We will send a Redwood DPA draft + SCC options for your review (Controller-to-Processor module recommended).
3) Please confirm whether AcmeHealth needs a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) in addition to the DPA/SCCs.
4) If possible, share the procurement contact for PO/contracting cadence so we can route the DPA for execution.

I've cc'd our legal/security leads (Marissa and Rishi) so they can jump in on technical/contract items.

Attachments: none in this message - planning to send DPA+SCC materials within the hour.

Thanks -

Following up from Neha's send - I'm Marissa from Redwood Legal. A few quick confirmations and proposed timeline:

1) Role alignment: confirmed - AcmeHealth = Controller; Redwood = Processor. We'll proceed with the Controller-to-Processor SCC modules as the baseline.

2) DPA & BAA: our draft includes optional BAA language in Appendix B. If you confirm BAA is required, we'll pull that into the main DPA and provide a BAA execution schedule.

3) SOC 2 attestation: Rishi can provide the full redacted report; the attached PDF is the latest copy we typically share for vendor reviews. If you need an auditor contact for expedited validation, let me know.

4) Procurement / timeline: please confirm your procurement contact and target signature date. For straightforward DPA + SCC (no additional amendments), we typically turn around final signature within 5-7 business days after comments are received. If Acme needs custom healthcare clauses, plan for an additional 1-2 weeks depending on negotiation scope.

Related links: HubSpot deal record: https://hubspot.example/ACME-2234 (Neha - feel free to update the expected close date).
